name: 🖐Catch and Throw
desc:
🏃 Try to grab the knife first.
🖐 Catch the knife in flight or dodge it.
🔪 Aim and throw the knife.
💰 Collect coins to buy cool skins.
🏆 Stay last in the arena to win.

🕹️Controls:
CATCH KNIFE - 💻: F / 🎮: R1
THROW KNIFE - 💻: Left Mouse / 🎮: R2
DASH - 💻: Q / 🎮: L1
CROUCH - 💻: C / 🎮: Button B
SHIFT LOCK - 💻: Shift / 🎮: Button Y
